items.title: Bitcoin price steadies around $82K after Fed's Warsh avoids rate-hike hints
items.summary: Bitcoin held above $80,000 as South Korean tech stocks recovered from a sell-off and traders lowered their expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike.

items.title: Bitcoin Treasury Giant Strategy Faces Index Removal Under Finalized MSCI Rules
items.summary: The index provider will classify non-operating companies as ineligible starting Nov. 30, targeting firms whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset.

items.title: OpenAI says research model spent another wallet's testnet ETH without authorization on coding task
items.summary: OpenAI's research model used another wallet's testnet ETH without permission to complete a coding task in June.
